summary: Iteration 23 — Auto-Feature Winner, Weekly Recap (preview + send), Theme Signup and Related-By-Theme all validated end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass against external URL. (1) POST /admin/insights/auto-feature-run?week=current returns {success:true, winner:<slug>} where winner matches the slug we pumped 6 views into via /insights/track; a subsequent GET /service-insights-featured returns exactly that winner slug. 401 without token. (2) GET /admin/insights/recap-preview?week=current returns {total_reads,total_shares,top_read[],top_shared[],by_theme[]} reflecting the just-tracked reads and a quote share; POST /admin/insights/recap-run?week=current returns {sent:true, queued:true, week:<isoweek>} (email is live). 401 without token on both. (3) POST /insights/track {event:share, platform:quote} increments shares_week (visible in recap-preview top_shared). (4) POST /newsletter with themes ['Technology','M&A','NotARealTheme'] stores interests_themes=[Technology, M&A] on the subscriber (invalid themes filtered); second POST with same email returns 'already subscribed' idempotently; test subscriber cleaned up via direct mongo. (5) GET /api/service-insights/<slug> now returns theme and related_by_theme (4 cross-service cards excluding current). Frontend: (a) Homepage / newsletter section shows Pick your themes chooser (data-testid newsletter-themes) with exactly 8 chips signup-theme-<Theme>; toggling chips and submitting posts themes in the body (would post, but hCaptcha strict blocks submission with 'Please complete the captcha' UI notice — chips + selection state confirmed). (b) Reader /insight/<slug> renders 'More in {theme}' section (data-testid related-by-theme) with 4 theme-rel-<slug> cards. (c) Admin /admin SK Insights tab shows 'Email me the recap' (send-recap) next to 'Send newsletter now' (send-newsletter); clicking send-recap hits POST /admin/insights/recap-run with 200. (d) Regression: trending-strip and featured-insight banner on /insights-hub, share-sk-take, key-takeaways, sk-insight and share-bar on reader all still render.

integration_issues.issue: hCaptcha strict mode blocks form submission from automation; theme selection + POST wiring is correct (verified via backend API + selection state). Real users must solve captcha before submit — expected but not covered by UI e2e.

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1)' persist (carried from it22) — non user-facing.

action_items: Non-blocking (carried): Recharts ResponsiveContainer renders at -1x-1 dims on mount in InsightsAdmin — wrap with minHeight or delay mount.
Non-blocking: server.py is now 6,750 lines — the SK Insights + recap surface (~500 LOC) should be extracted into an insights_router module for maintainability.

Nice-to-have: _weekly_recap_stats uses two separate week keys ('week' for reads, 'share_week' for shares) on the same doc — an insight with reads this week but shares last week (or vice-versa) is counted correctly, but the two-field convention is easy to break; consider a single {week, reads, shares} sub-doc keyed by iso-week.

Nice-to-have: _auto_feature_winner returns None (and rotates queue) when there are no reads — that is the documented fallback, but the endpoint still returns {success:true, winner:null}; callers may want a clearer 'no_winner' status.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /admin/insights/auto-feature-run overwrites app_meta.slug and index=<winner index> unconditionally — if the previously-live pick was 'pinned' by an admin mid-week, this Monday job silently replaces it. Consider skipping when auto_winner === current week's winner already.
_weekly_recap_stats reads all insight_stats (to_list(500)) every call — fine at current scale but should filter by {week: wk} $or {share_week: wk} to bound the working set.
POST /newsletter silently truncates themes to first 8 — safe, but a 400 on unknown themes would give the frontend real feedback (currently invalid themes are dropped without any signal).
POST /admin/insights/recap-run fires asyncio.create_task without awaiting/logging — a raised exception inside _send_weekly_recap is swallowed. Wrap in try/except with logger.exception.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all admin + reader + hub flows; newsletter submission blocked by hCaptcha strict mode as-designed)

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; all four enhancements (auto-feature winner, weekly recap preview+run, theme signup with invalid-theme filtering + idempotency, related-by-theme) ship correctly and regression flows are intact.
